statement: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ¬ k.Prime → f k = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k) = (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun k => k % 4 = 1), f k) + (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun k => k % 4 = 3), f k) + (if 2 ≤ n then f 2 else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 将任意仅在素数上有权重的有限和，精确分解为模四的两个奇剩余类与素数二的例外项
plain_statement.en: Split any finite prime-supported weight sum into the two odd classes modulo four and the exceptional prime two

brief.zh: 为 FR-7022 的 fixed-ap-theta-half-budget 中 q=1、q=2 归约提供可复用的纯代数输入。对 q=2，任意加权奇类可分成模 4 的 1、3 类；对 q=1，仅在素数上非零的权额外加上 2 的有限范围指示项。原 BMOR 显式解析估计仍单独待证。
brief.en: Provides an exact algebraic input for reducing q=1 and q=2 in fixed-ap-theta-half-budget. The odd class modulo 2 splits into classes 1 and 3 modulo 4; a prime-supported total sum adds only the exceptional prime 2. The explicit BMOR analytic inequality remains open.
